diagnosis: The industrial telemetry endpoint constructs an InfluxDB Flux query that filters measurements using factoryId directly from the request body. It fails to verify that req.user has authorization for the specified factoryId. Any authenticated employee from Factory A can query vibration and temperature sensor streams of Factory B, leaking production activity and operational metrics.
exploit_request:
POST /api/telemetry/flux-query HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.industrialcloud.org
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "factoryId": "factory_munich_plant_04",
  "timeRange": "-2h"
}
